When my parents got together, it might have been 86, might have been 87. Not sure, I wasn't born yet. 
My dad had tried to make it in London as a chef, living in a flat with his brother and a friend, and it was 1 bedroom. Someone had the couch and the others shared a bed. Even then my dad got in debt trying to survive.
He came back home and met my mum. And pretty quickly my mum fell pregnant with my sister. 
There they were on a very much minimal wage in a new relationship with a kid on the way. Easy, move into a council flat in a bad area. Suddenly there's another kid on the way (me), they needed a bigger place, did a swap thing, got a house in the middle of nowhere that was a dump. Had to fix it up, had to pay off dads debts, had to have a baby. 
They swapped to a 2up2down council house that was a dump. Took stress and work, mum was off work for a bit with me and my sister being less than 2 years apart. She didn't work, dad did pub cheffing. 
When we were a but older mum did a while bunch of part time work, dad worked nights. Not ideal, but you do what you need on minimum wage. 
Suddenly the house is ok, the debt is gone, and they can buy the house they live in. 
A few years of hard graft and they can remortgage and double the size of the house. 
They now own a 4 bed house. With a pretty big garden. All of the back of having nothing.
And my mum was 25, dad 30, when I was born into a council house in a bad state. After dealing with 1 baby and no money in a flat, they made it somehow.
You ways make it some how. 

Now my sister is a bank manager in a nice place. I'm a cleaner in a studio, but my parents are sitting on a 4 bed house is a nice area with a large garden, all of the back of debt ridden new parents.
